$comment: Two-tier budgets (win32 baseline, 2026-07-02). Top-level = the DEFAULT (Node) runtime floor, which is what v1 installs by default and what testDispatchRssWithinCeiling enforces: latencyP95Ms 150 (baseline-node p95 ~37-40 ms, pinned generously so cold-start noise never flakes); peakRssBytes 256 MiB (ref-node ##RSS self-report ~47 MiB, generous). `native` = the R-009 hot-path target (decision #18), pinned from measurement and enforced by `npm run bench:check`: latencyP95Ms 60 (baseline-native p95 ~5-10 ms, ~8x headroom — catches a regression toward Node speed without flaking); peakRssBytes 32 MiB (a small static Zig binary's peak RSS is a few MiB, far below the Node path). Native RSS is measured via the impl's /usr/bin/time peak on POSIX/CI and is n/a on Windows (no portable child-peak-RSS probe) — the native RSS gate skips-with-notice there, never a false green. This EXTENDS the provisional Node-path pin rather than replacing it (the Node floor still guards the default runtime).
